en: A black-and-white aerial photograph of a rural village, featuring small detached houses, open fields, a few tree-lined roads, and surrounding forested areas. The upper part of the image shows dense forest, while the lower part focuses on cultivated farmland, intersected by a main road and dotted with houses and some outbuildings. No prominent landmarks are visible. There is no visible text on the image.
